maya.l: hit confusing behavior in JS SDK today: throws ApiError('unauthorized') but response status is 403 so our background job doesn't refresh token.

ben_r: Oof. That's rough. We should not conflate 401 vs 403.

zoe: Proposal: typed errors hierarchy under ApiError: AuthError (401), PermissionError (403), RateLimitError (429), TransientError (5xx). Each error should expose http_status and optional retry_after.

patrick: Also include a brief migration plan: keep ApiError as base, add subclassing so existing catch-all still works. Add telemetry tag for "error_class".

maya.l: sample snippet callers can copy: 
```js
try { await client.generate(...) } catch (err) { if (err instanceof AuthError) { await refreshToken(); return } if (err instanceof RateLimitError) { await sleep(err.retry_after * 1000); return } throw err }
```

devex-bot: created DE-2020: "sdk: error subclasses + retry hints" assigned to @zoe.

ben_r: small doc note: error.message should be actionable, avoid raw 'Unauthorized'. e.g. "token expired; refresh once".

maya.l: leaving this here so folks running background workers see it. will test RFC once posted. :thumbsup:
